senses.gloss: prop. one who pours water over another person’s hands (cmp.
units: II Kings III, 1 hence (= שַׁמָּשׁ) attendant, waiter, esp. attendant of a dining club, serving at the table and collecting assessments, fees &c.

<cite ref="Shabbat 148a:1">Sabb. 148ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Bava Kamma 119a:5">B. Kam. 119ᵃ</cite> <he>אדא ד׳</he> (<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shabbat 2:1:18">Y. Sabb. II, 4ᵈ</cite> top <he>אדא שמשא</he>) Ada, the waiter.

<cite ref="Pesachim 86b:11">Pes. 86ᵇ</cite> <he>והוא דרגש בהו ד׳</he> provided the club-keeper has taken notice of them (Ms. M. 1 <he>דגָשׁ וכ׳</he> the club-keeper knows them well; Ms. M. 2 <he>דהדר בהו ד׳</he> that he went around for them to see whether they are all in).

<cite ref="Yoma 18a:13">Yoma 18ᵃ</cite> (prov.) <he>אי בר אחתיך ד׳ הוי חזי בשוקא קמיה וכ׳</he> if thy sister’s son has been appointed a constable, look out that thou pass not before him in the street (for he knows thy affairs well and may blackmail thee).
